mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEDICAL_RECORD (MEDICAL_RECORD_ID, USER_ID, HOSPITAL_NAME, PAYMENT_DATE, PRICE, MEMO) VALUES (SEQ_MEDICAL_RECORD.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{hospitalName}, TO_DATE(#{paymentDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{price}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT MEDICAL_RECORD_ID AS medicalRecordId, USER_ID AS userId, HOSPITAL_NAME AS hospitalName, TO_CHAR(PAYMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS paymentDate, PRICE, MEMO FROM MEDICAL_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY PAYMENT_DATE ASC, MEDICAL_RECORD_ID ASC
